context:
Goal: cloud sessions stop to ask far less, for acts you already granted: a lane's lease push to its own branch, cancelling its own CI run, and deleting its own check-in.
Why you: auto mode accepts a settings.json change only on words you type in the acting session. A page answer cannot grant it (decision relayed-grant-read-from-page, the settings exception). This replaces item 352.
Based on (ruling): you granted these acts on items 257 a (the sha form of a lease push) and 278 c and d (cancel own CI run, delete own check-in), and at 13:16 CST said sessions can and should add auto-mode allow lines for themselves (decision auto-mode-owner-acts). So no new question: only the typed go.
Based on (measured): docs/debts/notes.md: a lease push to a lane's own branch was refused 11 times on Nov 2-4.
Departs from: main's autoMode.allow — adds "Own Branch Lease Push" (a --force-with-lease push, sha form or --force-if-includes, to a branch the session pushed earlier; never --force, -f, +refspec, the default branch, archive/, roadmap, merge-lock, --mirror, --all, or a delete); a cancel of the session's own branch's CI run; and delete_trigger on its own check-in.
Still refused, not asked: a bare --force-with-lease, rule edits, agents interrupting or creating sessions, a merge onto red main, and a remote branch delete with no archive.
Steps: open the link and type the line below. Then press Done here.

go: add the "Own Branch Lease Push", own CI run cancel and own check-in delete entries to settings.json autoMode.allow, as drafted in lane lease-push-c-and-d (items 257 a, 278 c and d)
